resumo: FIZEMOS A ENTREGA DE 170 PACOTES DE PASCOA EM DOIS CMEIS DA CIDADE DE UNIAO DA VITORIA/PR, LEVANDO CARINHO E ALEGRIA AS CRIANCAS.

On March 14, 2026, we participated in the President-Elect Training, promoted by Rotary and held in the city of Campos Novos/SC. Representing our club, our partner Stefan Kolb was present, who will assume the presidency of the Rotary Club of Porto União – União da Vitória in the 2026–2027 term.

titulo: VISIT TO THE ROTARY CLUB OF CANOINHAS
resumo: On the night of February 18, 2026, colleagues Thiago Jorge Iwanko, Daniela Bochnia Iwanko and Stefan Kolb were present at the meeting of the Rotary Club of Canoinhas, in a moment of companionship, exchange of ideas and sharing of experiences between the clubs.

titulo: REVITALIZATION ROTARY MILESTONE OF RC PORTO UNIAO - UNIAO DA VITORIA
resumo: In 2025, work began on revitalizing the Rotary Landmark, adapting it to Rotary's new identity and public image standards. After work was completed, the revitalized landmark was officially reopened on January 15, 2025.

We participate in the activities of the football project developed in the Vice-King community, an initiative that began during the presidency of comrade Marcos Sauran and which continues to contribute to the development and integration of children and young people in the community.
